Yes, having single point of failure built into your service at a fundamental level is not a good idea at all.

Never assume your hard dependencies will be available forever. Use multiple availability zones, not just one, and either have a fallback or go into read-only state where you depend on backups/cache only.

Also, S3 might seem like a very simple service from the outside but in reality it's extremely complex for just HTTP file storage. The bigger it grows the more likely the outages.
